preserveReasons.set-up_y2: Structural second-year festival map and control command script; preserved byte-for-byte.

corrections: Translated and reread winter8 source ordinals 47 through 51 directly from English, including all thirteen quoted second-year event fields.
Preserved the complete second-year setup script byte-for-byte and kept every event command, numeric parameter, multiplayer branch and quoted-field boundary unchanged.
Reused the reviewed competition, prize, ending and loss wording, with locked Леден фестивал and consistent подледен риболов terminology.
